title_en: Jiangsu Nantong Erjian Group Co., Ltd. v. Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., Pudong Branch, et al. — dispute over a construction project construction contract
ruling_gist_en: If a contractor issues a false certificate of receipt of project funds, the people's court will not support its claim for priority right to be reimbursed for the construction project price for its unsatisfied claims for project funds.

full_text_en:
Jiangsu Nantong Erjian Group Co., Ltd. v. Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., Pudong Branch, et al. — dispute over construction engineering contract

Ruling Summary

Where a contractor issues a false certificate of receipt of project funds and claims a priority right to compensation for the construction project price regarding the creditor's rights for project funds that have not been satisfied, the People's Court shall not support such claim.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court
(2021) Supreme People's Court Min Shen No. 3629

Re-application Applicant (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Jiangsu Nantong Erjian Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 683 Renmin Middle Road, Qidong City, Jiangsu Province.
Legal Representative: Yang Xiaodong, Chairman of the Board.
Agent ad litem: Zhang Bing, lawyer of Gaopeng (Shanghai) Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Chen Hao, lawyer of Jincheng Tongda & Neal (Shanghai) Law Firm.

Respondent (Third Party at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., Pudong Branch, domiciled at No. 1500 Century Avenue, China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone.
Person in Charge: Yang Yuanjun, Branch Manager.
Agent ad litem: Lin Yuhan, lawyer of Shanghai Branch of Beijing Huicheng Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Wang Tao, lawyer of Shanghai Branch of Beijing Huicheng Law Firm.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Respondent at Second Instance): Shanghai Jiacheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room A019, Building 1, No. 1628 Suzhao Road, Minhang District, Shanghai.
Legal Representative: Tian Wentao, Chairman of the Board.

Managing Partner: Shanghai Wuniu Asset Management Co., Ltd. (designated representative: Han Xiao).
Agent ad litem: Wu Ruanchao, lawyer of Shanghai Jinmao Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Gu Qingwen, lawyer of Shanghai Jinmao Law Firm.

Defendant at First Instance, Respondent at Second Instance: Wuniu Equity Investment Fund Management Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 312, Building 2, No. 555 Guangming Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai.
Legal Representative: Han Xiao, Executive Director.
Agent ad litem: Wu Ruanchao, lawyer of Shanghai Jinmao Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Gu Qingwen, lawyer of Shanghai Jinmao Law Firm.

Defendant at First Instance, Respondent at Second Instance: Shenzhen Wuniu Equity Investment Fund Management Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 201, Building A, No. 1 Qianwan First Road, Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Cooperation Zone, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province.
Legal Representative: Han Xiao, Executive Director and General Manager.
Agent ad litem: Wu Ruanchao, lawyer of Shanghai Jinmao Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Gu Qingwen, lawyer of Shanghai Jinmao Law Firm.

The Re-application Applicant Jiangsu Nantong Erjian Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Nantong Erjian), in the case of a dispute over a construction engineering contract with the Respondents Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., Pudong Branch (hereinafter referred to as Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch), Shanghai Jiacheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jiacheng Real Estate Company), and the Defendants at First Instance and Respondents at Second Instance Shanghai Jiacheng Enterprise Development Co., Ltd., Shanghai Xukuan Enterprise Development Co., Ltd., Shanghai Wuniu Sufu Investment Center (Limited Partnership), Wuniu Equity Investment Fund Management Co., Ltd., and Shenzhen Wuniu Equity Investment Fund Management Co., Ltd., dissatisfied with the civil judgment (2020) Hu Min Zhong No. 433 of the Shanghai High People's Court, applied to this Court for a retrial. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to conduct the review, and the review has now been concluded.

Nantong Erjian applied for a retrial on the grounds that: This case falls under the circumstances provided in Items 1, 3, and 6 of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and should be retried. The main facts and reasons are as follows: (1) The main evidence on which the original judgment was based was forged. The new evidence submitted by Nantong Erjian in its retrial application, including the case acceptance notice of Qidong City Public Security Bureau, the notice of expert opinion, the decision to place a case on file, and the judicial expert opinion of Suzhou Tongji Judicial Appraisal Institute, can prove that the official seals of Nantong Erjian on the Supplementary Agreement to the Construction Engineering Construction Contract involved in the case and on the Confirmation Letters of Funds Received by the Construction Party dated March 31, 2016, May 10, 2016, and May 23, 2016 were all forged, and that Nantong Erjian was not aware of Jiacheng Real Estate Company's application to Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch for a loan and did not cooperate with Jiacheng Real Estate Company in transferring the loan funds. Nantong Erjian's return of the RMB 115,692,901 it had received to Jiacheng Real Estate Company was an act of performance and there was no fault. (2) Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch was at fault and was not a bona fide third party. The new evidence submitted by Nantong Erjian in its retrial application, including the announcement of the Shanghai Municipal Supervision Commission, the real property registration information of Shanghai, the Loan Contract for Entrusted Loans in RMB of Shanghai Bank, and the Construction Engineering Construction Contract of Shanghai, proves that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch cooperated with Jiacheng Real Estate Company to misappropriate the loan for repaying high-interest bridge loans, and it failed to review the forged General Contract Construction Engineering Contract of Jiacheng Real Estate Company and failed to directly disburse the loan to Nantong Erjian's account in accordance with regulations. (3) Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch does not enjoy a mortgage right over the project involved in the case. First, Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch only registered an advance notice of mortgage over the project involved in the case, but did not register the mortgage, so the mortgage right was not established. Second, even if Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch registered a mortgage over the project under construction, the new evidence submitted by Nantong Erjian in its retrial application, including the concrete compressive strength test report, the steel welding mechanical property test report, the engineering change visa contact slip, the excavation order, and the construction commencement report, can also prove that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch does not enjoy a mortgage right over the two newly constructed towers and the main structure that were built after the signing of the mortgage contract. (4) Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch is a third party without independent claims and does not have the right to appeal. (5) The priority right to compensation for the construction project price is a statutory right. If it conflicts with the mortgage right, the priority order should be determined based on the facts of the case, and the right enjoyed by Nantong Erjian should not be directly deprived.

Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch submitted its opinion, stating: (1) Nantong Erjian issued a total of 11 confirmation letters regarding funds, and the contents of each letter were continuous. The expert opinion submitted by Nantong Erjian alone is insufficient to overturn Nantong Erjian's admission in the original trial that some of the confirmation letters regarding funds were issued by it, nor to overturn the original court's determination of the facts in that regard. (2) Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch did not act wrongfully; it both reviewed the progress of the project and required Nantong Erjian to issue the Confirmation Letters of Funds Received by the Construction Party to protect its mortgage right. On the contrary, after receiving the funds, Nantong Erjian privately transferred them back to Jiacheng Real Estate Company and deliberately concealed the actual project contract and payment situation, showing obvious malicious intent. (3) The effective judgment (2018) Hu 01 Min Chu No. 784 of the Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court has confirmed that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch legally enjoys the mortgage right over the project involved in the case. (4) As the mortgagee of the project involved in the case, Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch is a third party with a legal interest in this case and has the right to appeal in accordance with the law. (5) The priority right to compensation for the construction project price claimed by Nantong Erjian cannot be asserted against the mortgage right of Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch.

Upon review, this Court holds that: (1) Regarding whether Nantong Erjian should enjoy the priority right to compensation for the construction project price over the project involved in the case. The priority right to compensation for the construction project price is a statutory priority right enjoyed by the construction contractor, but the contractor shall not abuse this right, and under specific circumstances, due to the contractor's own wrongful conduct, it may also lose the priority right to compensation for the construction project price. In this case, whether Nantong Erjian should enjoy the priority right to compensation for the construction project price over the project involved in the case should be determined comprehensively based on factors such as Nantong Erjian's subjective fault in implementing the acts, the consequences, whether it damages the lawful rights and interests of others, and whether it affects the interests of construction workers. First, from the perspective of subjective fault, Nantong Erjian admitted in the original trial that it had issued to Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch five Confirmation Letters of Funds Received by the Construction Party, dated March 31, May 10, May 23, August 22, and August 30, 2016, respectively, confirming receipt of project funds totaling RMB 261,466,700. As a market entity that has been engaged in professional engineering construction for a long time, Nantong Erjian should have been aware of the purpose of Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch's request for it to issue the confirmation letters of funds received and the legal consequences of issuing such confirmation letters. Under these circumstances, Nantong Erjian still issued to Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch Confirmation Letters of Funds Received by the Construction Party that were inconsistent with the actual amount of project funds received and returned RMB 115,692,901 of the RMB 145,432,901 it actually received in project funds to Jiacheng Real Estate Company, thereby cooperating with Jiacheng Real Estate Company in siphoning off the loan from Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch. Nantong Erjian's conduct was subject to significant fault, and it should bear the corresponding legal liability. Second, from the perspective of the consequences of the conduct, the five confirmation letters of funds issued by Nantong Erjian, as admitted by it in the original trial, stated that it had received a total of RMB 261,466,700 in project funds from Jiacheng Real Estate Company, which exceeded the total price of the construction project undertaken by Nantong Erjian as determined by the original court, i.e., RMB 157,704,663.49. The fact that the employer owes project funds is the prerequisite and basis for the contractor to enjoy the priority right to compensation for the construction project price. The project funds confirmed as received by Nantong Erjian in the confirmation letters of funds received exceeded its actual due project funds. Due to its own wrongful conduct, Nantong Erjian lost the factual basis for claiming the priority right to compensation for the construction project price and should no longer enjoy such priority right. Third, from the perspective of whether it damages the rights and interests of others, although Nantong Erjian issued the five confirmation letters of funds received to Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch, this conduct resulted in the loan that Jiacheng Real Estate Company obtained from Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch, which was originally intended to pay the project funds, being misappropriated for other purposes, while the project funds entitled to priority right remained unsatisfied. This inevitably affected the satisfaction of the creditor's rights of other creditors of Jiacheng Real Estate Company. Therefore, Nantong Erjian's conduct of issuing the confirmation letters of funds received not only damaged the lawful rights and interests of Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch, but also damaged the lawful rights and interests of other creditors of Jiacheng Real Estate Company. The creditor's rights for project funds that Nantong Erjian holds against Jiacheng Real Estate Company should no longer have priority over the loan creditor's rights that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch holds against Jiacheng Real Estate Company, nor over the creditor's rights that other creditors hold against Jiacheng Real Estate Company. Fourth, Nantong Erjian did not provide evidence to prove that its failure to enjoy the priority right to compensation for the construction project price over the project involved in the case would damage the interests of construction workers. In summary, the judgment of the second instance that Nantong Erjian, due to its own wrongful conduct, does not enjoy the priority right to compensation for the construction project price over the project involved in the case is not improper. The new evidence submitted by Nantong Erjian in its retrial application, including the case acceptance notice of Qidong City Public Security Bureau, the notice of expert opinion, the decision to place a case on file, and the judicial expert opinion of Suzhou Tongji Judicial Appraisal Institute, is insufficient to overturn its admission in the original trial that the above five confirmation letters of funds received were issued by it, nor can it prove that the Confirmation Letters of Funds Received by the Construction Party determined in the original trial were all forged; the new evidence submitted in its retrial application, including the announcement of the Shanghai Municipal Supervision Commission, the real property registration information of Shanghai, the Loan Contract for Entrusted Loans in RMB of Shanghai Bank, and the Construction Engineering Construction Contract of Shanghai, is insufficient to prove that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch acted with subjective malice or failed to perform its reasonable duty of review. The above evidentiary materials submitted by Nantong Erjian do not constitute new evidence sufficient to overturn the original judgment as provided in Item 1 of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

(2) Regarding whether Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch enjoys the mortgage right over the project involved in the case. Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch and Jiacheng Real Estate Company entered into a loan contract and a mortgage contract with respect to the project involved in the case and registered an advance notice of mortgage over the project involved in the case. Moreover, the fact that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch enjoys the mortgage right over the project involved in the case has been confirmed by the effective civil judgment (2018) Hu 01 Min Chu No. 784 of the Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court. The original court's determination that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch enjoys the mortgage right over the project involved in the case is not improper. Nantong Erjian's claim that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch does not enjoy the mortgage right over the project involved in the case is not established. The new evidence submitted by Nantong Erjian in its retrial application, including the concrete compressive strength test report, the steel welding mechanical property test report, the engineering change visa contact slip, the excavation order, and the construction commencement report, is insufficient to overturn the above determination of the original judgment and does not constitute new evidence as provided in Item 1 of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

(3) Regarding whether Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch has the right to appeal in this case. Nantong Erjian's claim for priority right to compensation for the discounted or auctioned price of the project involved in the case is directly related to the priority order of Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch's realization of the mortgage right over the project involved in the case. The outcome of this case has a legal interest for Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch. Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch's participation in this lawsuit as a third party at first instance complies with the provisions of Article 56 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. The judgment of the first instance, which determined that Nantong Erjian enjoys the priority right to compensation for the discounted or auctioned price of the project involved in the case, has substantially affected the exercise and realization of the mortgage right over the project involved in the case enjoyed by Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch. As a result of the judgment of the first instance, Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch has actually borne the corresponding legal consequences. Under these circumstances, the court of second instance determined that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch has the right to appeal, which is not improper. Nantong Erjian's claim that Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Pudong Branch has no right to file an appeal in this case is also not supported by this Court.

In summary, the grounds for retrial raised by Nantong Erjian cannot be established, and its application for retrial does not meet the circumstances provided in Items 1, 3, and 6 of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. Pursuant to Paragraph 1 of Article 204 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Paragraph 2 of Article 395 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

The application for retrial of Jiangsu Nantong Erjian Group Co., Ltd. is dismissed.

Presiding Judge: Wang Jun
Judge: Xue Guizhong
Judge: Du Weike

August 10, 2021

Court Clerk: Sheng Jialu
